title: sg_apicore: overview film
description: A documented REST API for TYPO3. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 56 seconds: sg_apicore for TYPO3 v14. A request in the browser; A table, behind a token; Every endpoint, also as an MCP tool. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A mobile app, a partner portal or an AI agent needs clean JSON. Every hand-built endpoint needs login, limits and docs.
sg_apicore turns TYPO3 content into a REST API, with live Swagger docs.
Try a request in the browser, and get JSON with pagination and rate-limit headers.
One registration exposes a table for list, read, create, update and delete, behind a token.
The backend lists each endpoint with its login mode, its scopes and its MCP tool.
sg_apicore by sgalinski. Docs that stay in sync with the code.
